title: Zhuang, Guibei Language (ZGB) - L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: Guibei Zhuang is a stable indigenous language of China. It belongs to the Kra-Dai language family and is part of the Zhuang macrolanguage. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
